name: File attribute codes for on-board file uploads (inferred title)
purpose: Inferred from the data; not documented in any available ICD. A small lookup table (7 rows) of file categories used by Solar Orbiter's file-based uplink, which relies on PUS service 13 'large data transfer' commands such as TC(13,9) 'Accept First Uplink Part' whose application data include a Partition Id and a File Attribute. Each record gives a short name (PLAIN, OBCP, DEL, IMM, PAYLOAD, INVALID, OTHER), a one-letter code, a numeric code (0-6, repeated in two columns) and a description such as 'DELAYED TC' or 'IMMEDIATE TC'. The names OTHER and OBCP are referenced from column 6 of s13t, which suggests that s13a classifies the content of uploaded files (plain data, on-board control procedures, delayed or immediate telecommand sequences, payload context). The numeric codes do not match the on-board 'File types' textual calibration CCDT0082TX used by the File Attribute parameter (where 0 is FT_INVALID and 6 FT_PLAIN), so the codes are probably ground-side (inference). SCOS-2000 does not use this table; it belongs to mission tools.

fields.name: COL1
fields.description: Inferred: short name of the file attribute/category (PLAIN, OBCP, DEL, IMM, PAYLOAD, INVALID, OTHER). Unique.

fields.name: COL2
fields.description: Inferred: one-letter code of the category: N (PLAIN, PAYLOAD, INVALID, OTHER), O (OBCP), D (DEL), I (IMM). Exact meaning not determinable.

values.meaning: observed for PLAIN, PAYLOAD, INVALID, OTHER (meaning not determinable)

fields.name: COL3
fields.description: Inferred: numeric code of the category (PLAIN 0, OBCP 1, DEL 2, IMM 3, PAYLOAD 4, INVALID 5, OTHER 6). Always equal to COL4.

fields.name: COL4
fields.description: Inferred: second numeric code, identical to COL3 in all rows (perhaps a ground and an on-board value that happen to coincide).

fields.name: COL5
fields.description: Inferred: display or class name; equals COL1 except for PLAIN, whose value is PAYLOAD.

fields.name: COL6
fields.description: Inferred: human-readable description (e.g. 'DELAYED TC', 'IMMEDIATE TC', 'PAYLOAD CONTEXT').

relationships.note: s13t rows UNKNOWN and OBCP refer to OTHER and OBCP (inferred).
Same purpose but different numbering than the on-board 'File types' calibration (0 FT_INVALID ... 7 FT_FAT); not a foreign key (inferred).

history: Not part of any ICD issue nor of pyscos2000. Present in MIB__20250916M25925PFMS001_SOL (file dated 2021-06-03); absent from MIB__20200416M10720PFMS001_SOL and from the SWA database.
notes: All meanings inferred. The link to service 13 rests on the table names (s13*), on TC(13,9)/(13,11) definitions in ccf/cdf with parameters 'Partition Id' (PCD0D093, calibration CCDT0192TX) and 'File Attribute' (PCD0D096, calibration CCDT0082TX), and on matching values in s13p. 'a' in the name possibly stands for 'attribute' (inference).
